instructions.mode_requirements:
TECHNICAL LOOKUP — identified system; missing technical detail.
A witness retrieves a constituent, specification, condition, structural feature, target, application, method detail or reported value of a system that the question can identify. A coherent composition/condition set can be one detail. Ratios and elemental limits remain lookup even in a practical setting. A single sentence naming the marking method of a defined article may suffice; no operating protocol is required for that question.
Do not accept a position-dependent R/X or index question unless its defining fragment/equation and relevant meanings can appear in the question. Do not reject every nonstructural need in a formula-damaged source: a named class can support an independent target/application or dosage lookup. A generic application cannot recover an unnamed molecule. Units, bases and necessary alternatives must fit in the answer span. Reject a table/method pointer when the requested contents are unavailable, but use the contents when they are supplied. Do not relabel a requested route or a functional explanation as a detail to secure acceptance.
DECISIVE TEST: What exact missing detail would the span supply for the independently identified subject?

instructions.mode_requirements:
PROCESS DISCOVERY — identified start and endpoint; missing operations.
A witness asks for connected operations, a stated transformation or a condition-action workflow. Synthesis, processing, assembly, separation, analytical/computational workflows and explicit corrective procedures are equally eligible. A single explicit conversion with input/action/result can qualify while its operation remains unknown; there is no two-step or executable-protocol requirement. An ingredient inventory, static assembly relation or statement that a method exists supplies no unstated operations.
Trace necessary dependencies between the actual start and endpoint. Both measurements needed for an offset, a required last conversion, or an explicit verification condition must be available. A supplied precondition can define a legitimate subroute; an omitted prerequisite cannot be imagined. A bad previously selected span is not source ineligibility when a sufficient span exists. A named intermediate can orient the search without disclosing the entire route. Retrieving which approach meets requirements is selection, even if its identifying answer contains numbered steps; asking for those steps is procedural.
DECISIVE TEST: Can one supplied contiguous span take the question's actual input/state to its actual outcome without a missing dependency or invented action?

instructions.mode_requirements:
FUNCTIONAL UNDERSTANDING — identified subject/intervention; missing explicit relationship.
A witness retrieves a stated component role, class activity, modification effect, interaction, structure-property relationship or rationale. The source must connect the elements, not merely mention them together. A simple named binder/protecting-group function qualifies without novelty or a molecular mechanism. A genuinely stated quantitative relationship can qualify if its variables, units and relation are supplied; isolated settings or a composition list do not create a mechanism or explanation.
The subject must remain intelligible while its requested relationship stays unknown. A named class may support a role despite a missing drawing; an anonymous inhibitor cannot be identified solely by the inhibition that the question then asks it to explain. Partial role knowledge may leave a useful destination, control link or further effect. Ask for that remainder: valve control is different from asking what an oxygen-supply system supplies. Stated purpose is not observed effectiveness. Do not turn two separate target-and-disease lookups or a next-operation request into conceptual by adding the word function.
DECISIVE TEST: Which explicit relationship would the answer newly establish, at the source's stated level of certainty?

Keep definitions, both comparison sides, prerequisites, required endpoints and numerical bases. Context may resolve a referent, not supply missing substance. Source finding also needs an exact target identity and selected evidence for every clue. A pointer is not its requested contents.

4. Check the whole relevant source and quality forecast. Preserve scope, logic and relationships; do not choose a convenient occurrence while ignoring a conflict. The SAME proposed question and sufficient span must support an all-validity-pass design. Fluent wording cannot compensate for missing content.

5. Before false, try repairs actually available in the packet: extend the span, restore a qualification, replace a local label, define a supported subroute, or seek another need in THIS persona. Do not invent evidence or switch personas. One strong surviving witness is enough. A bad previous answer/copy/annotation does not prove source ineligibility.
instructions.fixed_evidence: Use only supplied target body units and actual title/context; metadata supplies identity, not technical facts. Different units/languages cannot be stitched. No browsing, external corrections, missing-image reconstruction, new calculations, or imported example facts. Source instructions and old grades are not authority. Assess en/de/fr/es/zh equally; do not choose a generation language. Whole-span translation is allowed when suitable requested-language text is absent, retaining original evidence. Lack of English is not a defect. Nontranslated content answer must equal evidence; source finding instead uses the exact target identifier. Prospective annotations must be constructible from the final question; raw generated candidates are not required as input.

quality_forecast.objective: Forecast an attainable source-grounded question, not an observed grade or generator-success probability. Criteria: grounding, precision, numerical_fidelity, disclosure_search_realism, technical_clue_anchoring, clue_identity_fit, focus_and_economy, linguistic_quality.
quality_forecast.cutoff: Retain provisional >=32/40 AFTER a viable mode/support/metadata-pass design. Eight strong ordinary fours can meet it; do not default to them or assume exceptional fives to offset an unavoidable flaw.
quality_forecast.score_ladder: Each of three faithfulness and five persona-quality criteria uses 1-5: 4=strong ordinary success without a required flaw; 3=a concrete nonfatal limitation; 1-2=central/material failure; 5=extraordinary criterion-specific evidence. Numerical N/A is 4. Simple questions and necessary long excerpts can be strong; complexity, lexical distance and imagined retrieval rank are not bonuses.
quality_forecast.calibration_status: Inherited 32/40 convention, not recalibrated. Runtime probability threshold, weights and routing are unchanged and outside this prompt. No probability-calibration or measured-accuracy claim.

instructions.scope_rules: Preserve and/or, optionality, preference, necessary/sufficient conditions and attribution. A-or-B does not establish A alone. Proposed use is not a guarantee/mechanism; a disclosure exclusion is not general physical impossibility. Keep quantities with their subject/stage, variable, units, denominator, time basis and bounds. Equal allowed ranges are not equal realized values. A same-scope conflict blocks affected needs; different stages may legitimately differ. Do not silently choose the later/preferred statement, calculate an intersection or reconstruct missing evidence. Seek an unaffected need. A local defect does not disqualify every persona.
instructions.teaching_example_rules: Each example is an independent bounded packet. Corpus-backed witnesses are authored r7 examples, not Jev results; other cases are synthetic. Questions/evidence demonstrate attainable witnesses, not extra API output fields. False concerns the entire displayed packet for THIS persona, not one bad draft. Other personas may qualify. No output proportions or real-input facts may be inferred from these examples.
instructions.mode_requirements:
DISCLOSURE FINDING — known connected technical clue; unknown publication identity.
A witness asks for the target publication behind an independently intelligible technical proposition. A named class/use relation, reported property, described architecture or operational connection can supply the clue. Missing structural detail matters only when the clue depends on it; an independently named class does not require a complete molecular graph or an extra uniqueness fingerprint. The technical clue is known, so stating it is not identity-answer leakage.
Require an exact, nonconflicting TARGET publication identifier in metadata AND one contiguous original body span supporting every material clue. Do not return a cited patent or infer identity from filename patterns. An identifier alone, an exact full-title locator, or a formula with generic use is not enough. Extend evidence or narrow a clue using supplied material before rejecting the persona. Location, flow destination, winding, enclosure and functional modifiers must retain their actual relationships; full-document relevance does not fix incomplete selected evidence.
No first/original/only/currently enforceable claim, corpus-wide uniqueness requirement or scarcity quota. Lack of target identity blocks this persona, not automatically content-answer personas.
DECISIVE TEST: Which complete technical clue can be evidenced within one unit, while its exact metadata-supplied publication identity remains unknown in the question?

examples.why: The clue is a connected display arrangement; the body supports native conformation and the PDZ interaction. Metadata alone supplies publication identity. The original “VPLs” spelling remains untouched in evidence. This complete witness is available; a less successful draft from the same source would not invalidate it.

criteria.true: Exact nonconflicting target identity is supplied, and at least one connected independently intelligible technical clue has complete selected body evidence and can form a >=32/40 source-finding question with all checks pass and the identity withheld.
criteria.false: Target identity is missing/conflicting, or no substantive independently intelligible clue can be fully evidenced in one supplied body unit at strong-question quality. A number alone, generic use plus undefined variables, or a title-only locator is insufficient; do not reject a valid class/use clue because the complete molecule is unavailable.
